OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[pf:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH p, t,
  CASE
    WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
    ELSE STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%B %-d, %Y')
  END AS birth_date
WITH p, t,
  DATE_PART('year', DATE('2026-10-15')) - DATE_PART('year', birth_date)
  - CASE
      WHEN DATE_PART('month', birth_date) > DATE_PART('month', DATE('2026-10-15'))
        OR (DATE_PART('month', birth_date) = DATE_PART('month', DATE('2026-10-15'))
            AND DATE_PART('day', birth_date) > DATE_PART('day', DATE('2026-10-15')))
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS age
WHERE age >= 42
   OR (t IS NOT NULL AND t.team_name <> 'Philadelphia 76ers')
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1,
       age AS col2,
       t.team_name AS col3,
       p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH p, t,
  CAST(RIGHT(p.birth_date, 4) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CASE
    WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
    WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) = 'January' THEN 1
    WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) = 'February' THEN 2
    WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) = 'March' THEN 3
    WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) = 'April' THEN 4
    WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) = 'May' THEN 5
    WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) = 'June' THEN 6
    WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) = 'July' THEN 7
    WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) = 'August' THEN 8
    WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) = 'September' THEN 9
    WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) = 'October' THEN 10
    WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) = 'November' THEN 11
    WHEN SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1) = 'December' THEN 12
  END AS birth_month,
  CASE
    WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
    ELSE CAST(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', '') AS INT64)
  END AS birth_day
WITH p, t,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE
    WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 15) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS age
WHERE age >= 42
   OR (t IS NOT NULL AND t.team_name <> 'Philadelphia 76ers')
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1, age AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, p.name AS name_player
